description: Looming-escape circuit of MaleCNS v1.0: LC4/LPLC2 detectors -> looming descending neurons, neurons on detector->DN paths of <= 2 edges with >= 5 synapses each.

model.equation: x <- x + (1/tau) * (-x + relu(W^T x + I)), one step = one model ms

detectors.elevation_note: rank of dendrite dorsoventral position within side and type; 0 = most dorsal

readout.group_rule: z < -3.0 (UP) or > +3.0 (DOWN) on both sides; negative = dorsal = upper visual field

provenance.licence: Data: MaleCNS v1.0, CC-BY 4.0 (Berg et al., Cell 2026). Code: MIT.
